values.summary: Implemented bounded, canonical, signed capability advertisement evidence with durable replay defense and exact live certificate authorization.
actual_changes: Added an unregistered distributed capability advertisement module with domain-separated Ed25519 signing, canonical JCS encoding, deterministic sorting and deduplication, exact certificate binding, durable bounded replay high-water state, and evidence-only projections.

Added a bounded path-based integration target with twelve focused tests covering valid projection, durable replay across expiry and restart, hard policy maxima, and all required fail-closed security and resource cases.

actual_validation.purpose: Validate canonical signatures, exact live certificate authorization, durable replay, absolute resource bounds, and fail-closed negative cases.
Prove immutable source and evidence introduction bindings for issue 5871.
